gr-independence.title: Flag of the Greek War of Independence

colors.note: The purity of the revolutionary cause.

desc: - The Greek War of Independence (1821) flag was a blue field with a white cross, the revolutionary banner that rallied Greeks against Ottoman rule
- **Construction:** a blue field with a white cross — the land version of the Greek flag during the War of Independence
trivia:
- Greece's independence flag (1821–1829) represented the War of Independence from Ottoman rule
- The cross and stripes reflected Greek Orthodox Christianity
- This flag inspired many other national symbols

gr-kingdom.title: Flag of the Kingdom of Greece

colors.note: Purity and the cross of Christianity.

desc:
- The flag of the Kingdom of Greece featured nine horizontal stripes of blue and white with a blue canton bearing a white cross
- Alternatively, a plain blue field with a white cross was used as the state flag
- The nine stripes are popularly said to represent the nine syllables of the Greek motto 'Ελευθερία ή Θάνατος' (Freedom or Death)
- The cross represented the Greek Orthodox faith
- **Construction:** nine alternating blue and white horizontal stripes with a blue canton containing a white cross. Ratio 2:3
trivia:
- The Kingdom of Greece flag represented the Greek monarchy
- Used from 1832 onwards with various heraldic modifications
- Greece became a republic in 1974

gr-junta.title: Flag of the Greek Military Junta
desc:
- During the Greek military junta (1967–1974), the regime used a dark blue flag with a white cross as the sole national flag, dropping the striped version
- The junta simplified the flag to the plain cross design, associating the striped version with democratic governance
- After the fall of the junta, the nine-stripe version was reinstated
- **Construction:** a dark blue field with a white cross centred, its arms extending to the edges. Ratio 2:3
trivia:
- The Greek junta flag (1967–1974) represented military dictatorship in Greece
- The cross was simplified to reflect authoritarian rule
- Democracy was restored after the fall of the junta
